Namrata and her team pulled an all-nighter, moved all the decorations into a beautiful inside area, and decorated the space in such a detailed way that in the end the haldi became one of our absolute favorite events of the weekend.

And besides their commitment to our vision of the perfect wedding and their determination to make it happen, the attention to detail and infusing the entire weekend with the essence of us and our relationship has truly blown us, our families, and our friends away. We cannot stress this enough, their attention to detail was nothing short of incredible. And we are not talking about the general details of an event, we mean the smallest imaginable details that one can easily miss during the wedding but then seeing it on the photos or hearing about it from friends and family that appreciated it, sweetens the memory of the wedding even more.

All in all, Namrata and the team of the Two Fat Ladies have made sure that we have memories that we can cherish for the rest of our lives. From the first stages of planning, through months of preparation, and lastly executing what in our eyes was the perfect wedding. We are grateful and thank them for all they did for us and can highly and warmly recommend Namrata and her team!

If you are looking for a wedding planner that is detailed oriented, very knowledgeable regarding the industry, clear communicators, very organized, can work with couples abroad, amazing at the day-off-handling, and committed to make sure your visions come true, then look no further: The Two Fat Ladies are the planners for you!

If not: Your loss and good luck :)

Daniel & Trisha
